sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: The upsides first: brings a clean fruit identity. It still contributes something valuable even when it is not elite. Easy to use as a whole food. Simple, recognisable, and realistic for everyday eating. Usually a strong swap for ultra-processed sweet snacks. That replacement value is one of the most important practical reasons apples remain such a solid fruit baseline.
